freshly_checked_applications.title: Crystalline inertial type at every original local residue prime
freshly_checked_applications.source: Matthew Emerton and Toby Gee, Moduli stacks of étale (phi,Gamma)-modules and the existence of crystalline lifts, Theorem 8.2.1; conventions Section 1.12
freshly_checked_applications.hypotheses_checked: Actual finite extension F/Qp, finite-image inertia type extending to the Weil group, arbitrary rank n>=1 and arbitrary smooth irreducible pi. No genericity or prime-to-rank restriction. The original complex normalization, fixed iota, descent to original O and every-map quantifiers are separately proved.

freshly_checked_applications.title: Singleton-segment Langlands quotient dictionary
freshly_checked_applications.source: Caraiani, Emerton, Gee, Geraghty, Paskunas, Shin, Patching and the p-adic local Langlands correspondence, Sections 1.8 and 3.1, Proposition 3.9; Theorem 3.7 for comparison
freshly_checked_applications.hypotheses_checked: Ordered rank-one smooth characters with mu_j != mu_i|.| for i<j, the exact geometric reciprocity convention and source Good/inj scope. No global patching restriction is imported into the separate unrestricted type application.

freshly_checked_applications.title: Cuspidal parameters, degree and elliptic values of finite general linear groups
freshly_checked_applications.source: J. A. Green, The characters of the finite general linear groups, Trans. AMS80 (1955),402–447, Theorems12–14, Lemma7.4, Definition3.1 and formula(12)
freshly_checked_applications.hypotheses_checked: Original finite field and supplied LabelDatum, exact Teichmuller embedding and generators, regular-character Frobenius orbits, degree-d simplex with partition(1), finite unnormalized parabolic induction, degree and elliptic sign. FLC15 supplies separate original-label uniqueness for the q>=5 consumer.
